extracted.intended_audience: citizens, businesses, non-governmental organisations, and other stakeholders interested in DG Competition public consultations
extracted.subtask_short: participating in EU DG Competition consultations
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and listing page for public consultations run by the European Commission's DG Competition, showing open and closed consultations, their topics, deadlines, and how to access past consultation material. Useful for stakeholders who want to submit views or find consultation results and follow-up information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility to participate / target audience
rubrics_metrics.description: The "Have Your Say" Portal provides a platform for all citizens (including businesses and non-governmantal organisations), to share their views on Commission initiatives at key stages in the legislative process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: By sharing your views and ideas with us, you can help us develop intiativies on a wide range of topics. (Implicit expectation: consultations are open to the general public and to organisations; submissions from these groups are the intended input.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Consultation entry metadata / required display fields
rubrics_metrics.description: This page lists the most recent public consultations published by DG Competition, including information on the results of the information provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each consultation listing is presented with at least the following columns/fields: Title, Policy activity, Closing date, and where relevant Results & follow-up or Contributions. Authors/administrators should ensure entries include these data points so stakeholders can identify topic, policy area, deadlines and outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consultation status and timeline (open vs closed listings)
rubrics_metrics.description: The page separates "Open market tests on Competition Policy", "Open consultations on Competition Policy", and "Closed consultations/market tests and comments received".
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consultations are grouped by status (open vs closed). Each item includes a closing date; stakeholders need to refer to that date to know whether they can still contribute. Closed consultations may link to results and follow-up information or to contributions received.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accessing older consultation records
rubrics_metrics.description: For requesting access to public consultations older than 2020 please send an email to COMP-WEB[at]ec[dot]europa[dot]eu (COMP-WEB[at]ec[dot]europa[dot]eu).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedural instruction for stakeholders: to obtain archived consultation materials predating 2020, contact the provided email address. (Implicit: older records are not directly available on the page and require a manual request.)
